source_limits: Live window evaluation is illustrative: labelled windows and ranking pairs are generated together and then split as individual entries. Evaluation windows or related same-composite examples may overlap training pairs; background mining also occurs before that split. Do not present this as independent held-out recognition accuracy.

The playground renders and trains on its own scene/placement. It is an independent experiment and does not explain the exact top game's current image/search unless an explicit bridge is implemented and verified.

The default list oracle scores windows classically before amplification, so it demonstrates Grover behavior without an end-to-end speedup. Coherent mode simulates a different quantum-only readout and still uses classically prepared/selected window features; efficient coherent input loading is not implemented.
Live logistic/CNOT/no-entangler comparisons are illustrative and use different thresholds/optimization schedules; they are not a controlled performance benchmark or evidence of quantum advantage.

Random live-training initializations can yield no accepted addresses after120 rounds. The saved demo checkpoint remains available via Show all details→Load demo weights. The frozen game's inference is independent and unchanged.
current_qa.retained_scientific_scope: The frozen standing Wanda detector, scene artwork, threshold and recognition pipeline remain unchanged. Historical native QNN 298/300 versus logistic 299/300 applies to the known Wanda PNG, supplied sizes, fully visible targets and five original unseeded background identities. The browser diagnostic's 15/15 target cases versus native 13/15 retains its separate original scope. Park's 40px/46px false acceptances, browser/native differences and iteration 19's arbitrary-drop abstention remain recorded failures. Live playground training does not refit or replace that frozen model and does not rerun its reserved evaluation.
retained_limits: Physical touch/pen, multi-touch, OS motion preference and unfamiliar users not directly tested
Park40/46 lookalike false acceptances and native/browser differences retained

One original full-body clip-art person, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. A coherent illustrated crowd-puzzle picture-book style: clean dark-brown ink outlines, simple flat warm colors, restrained shading, friendly small facial features, natural slightly cartooned proportions around six heads tall, clear separated shoes and limbs. No scene, no floor, no drop shadow, no glow, no lettering, no watermark, no other people. Do not use red-and-white striped clothes or make this person Wanda. The character is standing still, not walking.
